label: Let every combination finish when one fails
The Node and Postgres versions to support
A failure that must not fail the whole run
Postgres of the matrix version, ready before tests
code:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:${{ matrix.postgres }}
    env:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
    ports:
      - 5432:5432
    options: >-
      --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
      --health-interval 5s
      --health-timeout 5s
      --health-retries 10
